### How do I join PMA?

To join PMA, visit the membership page and complete the interest form. You’ll need to provide information about your company and your areas of interest. After submission, a member of PMA’s membership team will follow up with you and schedule a call to learn more. Membership is open to companies in the metalforming industry.

### How much is a yearly membership?

The yearly membership fee for PMA varies depending on your company’s size and type. Fees are structured to ensure accessibility for businesses of all sizes, from small manufacturers to large corporations. Contact PMA directly for a customized quote.

### How do I renew?

You will be sent your renewal notice via email. The email will contain your invoice and instructions to renew. Renewals typically go out to members in November. Complete the renewal process to ensure continuous access to all the resources and benefits that PMA offers. Renewal reminders are sent before your membership expires.

### Can I attend events if I’m not a member?

Nonmembers can attend most PMA events, but they will need to pay at the nonmember registration price, which is typically higher than the discounted rate available to members. PMA members enjoy reduced rates and priority access to these events, making membership a cost-effective option for regular attendees.

# PMA Hires Randy Kish as Membership Engagement Manager

  * March 29, 2021
  * By: PMA Staff

CLEVELAND, OH—March 29, 2021—The Precision Metalforming Association (PMA) announces the hiring of Randy Kish as membership engagement manager. 

In this role, Kish will manage PMA’s 16 districts and promote member participation at the local level. He also will support the association’s marketing efforts and assist the membership team in driving sales of PMA’s online METALFORM EDU training platform, the member health insurance program and in-plant training offerings.

From 2001 to 2010, Kish served as PMA’s marketing manager and then went on to hold sales and business-development positions for a few major press manufacturers.  

“We are very excited to welcome Randy back to PMA to strengthen and grow our local districts, and to assist in providing our member companies with necessary resources and service,” said David Klotz, PMA president. “Randy’s knowledge of the metalforming industry and passion for serving the PMA membership make him an outstanding addition to our staff.”   

To contact Randy Kish, call 216-901-8800 ext. 144, e-mail [email protected] or connect on LinkedIn. 

PMA is the full-service trade association representing the $137-billion metalforming industry of North America—the industry that creates precision metal products using stamping, fabricating, spinning, slide forming and roll forming technologies, and other value-added processes. Its more than 800 member companies also include suppliers of equipment, materials and services to the industry. PMA leads innovative member companies toward superior competitiveness and profitability through advocacy, networking, statistics, the PMA Educational Foundation, FABTECH tradeshows, and MetalForming and 3D Metal Printing magazines.

  * December 9, 2024
  * By: PMA Staff

CLEVELAND, OH—December 9, 2024—The Precision Metalforming Association (PMA) announces the hiring of Brittany Borden as marketing coordinator.

In this role, Borden will work closely with PMA’s membership engagement team to support the marketing activities of PMA’s 17 districts, including managing event and membership promotions, communications, developing marketing materials and analyzing feedback from program attendees to identify areas of improvement. She also will assist in the recruitment, engagement and retention of district volunteers.

“We are thrilled to welcome Brittany to PMA to support our local districts and provide our members with outstanding service,” said Randy Kish, PMA membership engagement manager. “Brittany’s knowledge in the latest marketing and communications trends, as well as her experience in a high-production marketing environment, make her an excellent addition to our staff.”  

Borden is a 2023 Summa Cum Laude graduate in Visual Communications Technology from Bowling Green State University. She most recently worked as a marketing and events coordinator at Pixel Connection in Avon, OH, as well as interned with the St. Ignatius High School Mothers’ and Fathers’ Club for event and volunteer recruitment promotions.

# PMA Mexico Came Together in a Big Way at FABTECH Mexico 2026

  * June 4, 2026
  * By: Drew

Image

Over three days in Mexico City, PMA national staff, Mexico District officers and industry partners worked side-by-side to strengthen relationships, engage manufacturers and continue building momentum for PMA’s growing presence throughout Mexico’s metalforming industry.

The week was filled with meaningful conversations, new connections and strong member engagement:

  * More than 130 productive booth conversations took place with manufacturers, suppliers and industry professionals
  * PMA Mexico officers volunteered all three days, managing booth engagement and outreach
  * District officers personally visited and introduced themselves to exhibitors throughout the METALFORM area
  * Salvador Ramirez, PMA Mexico District Director, presented a 30-minute conference session focused on the value of PMA membership and the district’s long-term growth strategy
  * The PMA Mexico Member Reception exceeded expectations, welcoming nearly 50 attendees for an evening focused on networking, collaboration and community

The event also created an important opportunity for PMA leadership teams across membership, workforce development, publishing and events to align around future opportunities supporting manufacturers in Mexico.

A special birthday celebration was also held during the show for Doug Trout, PMA FABTECH Director of Exhibitions, who celebrated his 65th birthday surrounded by friends, colleagues and members of the PMA Mexico community.

Thank you to everyone who helped make FABTECH Mexico 2026 such a productive and energizing experience. The conversations and relationships built during the week will continue shaping PMA Mexico’s future growth and engagement efforts in the months ahead.

# 2025 PMA District Leadership Conference – Leadership Elevated. Engagement Celebrated

  * July 25, 2025
  * By: PMA Staff

Image

#### 2025 District Leadership Conference – Leadership Elevated. Engagement Celebrated!

On June 25-26, the 2025 PMA District Leadership Conference brought together 50 volunteer officers, staff and regional champions from across North America for two days of energy, alignment and action. With the theme “From the Top,” the event highlighted PMA’s national transformation and empowered district leaders with the vision, tools and support to lead locally.

PMA 2025 Chair Gene Lambert and PMA President David Klotz set the stage with insights on the association’s strategic priorities—member engagement, workforce development, and technology integration—and how districts will play a central role in bringing those goals to life. Attendees explored new digital resources, including a Salesforce-powered engagement platform and community boards to strengthen member connections. New membership engagement team members were introduced, along with a reimagined district management focus.

Throughout the event, attendees shared challenges and successes in volunteer development and member engagement, event planning, onboarding and community outreach. Face-to-face strategies, from plant tours to school visits, paired with practical social media tips to amplify district visibility and impact were discussed.

From big ideas to small wins, this year’s conference marked a powerful step forward—uniting leaders and elevating PMA’s future From the Top. For more information and to get more engaged with PMA districts, contact Randy Kish.

### Who can join a networking group?

Any PMA member is eligible to apply to join a networking group. 

### What is the process to join a networking group?

PMA members first must submit an interest form. PMA staff will review the members request and pass along to the networking group members that best fit the PMA member. The group members will review the interest and decide to move forward with an invite to an upcoming meeting. After the meeting, the members will then decide on whether the member will join the group. 

### Is there a cost associated with joining a group?

# Who is an AMBA Member?

#### Who is an AMBA Member?

AMBA member companies are domestic mold manufacturers who build the majority of their molds in the U.S., either for customers in a variety of industries or for internal operations. 

Located across the country, AMBA members range in employee size from one individual to 200+. 

If you are a U.S. mold manufacturer interested in...

  * Becoming more profitable,
  * Having a voice on Capitol Hill, 
  * Learning from functional area peers,
  * Touring peer facilities,
  * Implementing new technologies,
  * Staying abreast of current economic and industry trends,
  * Workforce growth and development and/or
  * Accessing cost-reduction opportunities

then YOU are ready to benefit from AMBA membership!

Learn More and Join Today

#### AMBA Partners: Suppliers to the AMBA Community

AMBA partners are industry suppliers that provide U.S. mold builders with specific goods and services. AMBA partners traditionally do not make molds; rather, they provide ancillary goods and services that help U.S. mold manufacturers operate successfully. 

AMBA partners pay annual membership fees for access to the AMBA community, advertising opportunities and additional publicity in the annual AMBA Sourcebook publication.

Examples of AMBA partner company types include, but are not exclusive to:

  * 3D Printing
  * Advising and Consulting
  * CAD/CAM Services
  * Hot Runner Systems
  * Insurance
  * Marketing Services
  * Magnetic Systems
  * Mold and Die Components
  * MRO Supplies
  * Shipping Services
  * And More!
